name: ux-writing-audit
description: Audit product interface copy for clarity, consistency, voice, actionability, and localization readiness.

interface.longDescription: Audit buttons, labels, errors, empty states, toasts, and tooltips through clarity, consistency, voice, actionability, and localization lenses, then produce scored findings and a reusable glossary.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit this product's interface copy and build a terminology glossary across its locales.
